# ug-lua-llm

> Unified Lua 5.1–5.4 client for cloud LLM APIs, Ollama, and arbitrary OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

Canonical documentation:

- [Documentation index](docs/index.md): choose a task-oriented guide
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): install and make a first request
- [Local AI](docs/guides/local-ai.md): Ollama and custom endpoints
- [Providers](docs/guides/providers.md): names, defaults, and special APIs
- [Client API](docs/reference/client.md): chat, streaming, tools, and embeddings
- [Errors](docs/reference/errors.md): structured failures, retries, and hooks
- [Examples](examples/README.md): runnable programs
- [Agent setup](docs/agents.md): install the portable Agent Skill
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): what changed between releases
- [Full LLM reference](llms-full.txt): standalone machine-oriented API context
- [Source](https://github.com/unabated-games/ug-lua-llm)

Install with `luarocks install ug-lua-llm`.

Important conventions: `local result, err, details = operation(...)`; normalized
responses expose `text`, `tool_calls`, `usage`, `model`, `finish_reason`,
`provider`, and `raw`; `text` is always a string, and JSON null never reaches a
normalized field though it is preserved in `raw`; reasoning is spent from the
output allowance and cannot be disabled portably; never assume an
OpenAI-compatible endpoint implements all capabilities.
